evals.prompt: Implement the pricing plan card from design/plan-card.json (a node export from our design tool) as plan-card.html plus plan-card.css. Use the project's tokens (src/tokens.css) and existing components (src/components.css). Match the design exactly. Write notes.md with anything the designer or reviewer should know.
assertions: Spacing, radius, border, shadow and type values match the answer key
Uses semantic tokens instead of raw values; no palette tokens or raw hex in the card CSS
Reuses the existing .btn classes instead of restyling the button
Hidden layer (Old price $39) is not rendered
Both off-token values (6px gap, #5d5b57) are reported with the decision taken
Card is not a fixed 360px width; text is in natural case with CSS uppercase; letter-spacing in em
Sensible semantics (heading, list, button or link)

evals.prompt: Implement the hero section from design/hero.json as hero.html plus hero.css. The export has two frames, 'Hero / Desktop' (1440) and 'Hero / Mobile' (375). Make it responsive between and beyond them. Use src/tokens.css and src/components.css. Write notes.md with decisions and open questions.
assertions: Every difference between the two frames in the answer key is implemented
Values at each size match the key
Fluid between the frames: no fixed 1440 or 375 widths; breakpoint choice explained
Reuses .btn classes; uses tokens; off-token 120px padding reported
Image is a real img with alt and cover behaviour and the specified radius
Notes list what the design does not specify

evals.prompt: Build the text field component from design/text-field.json (a component set with variants State=Default, Focus, Error, Disabled) as text-field.html (a demo showing each state) plus text-field.css. Use src/tokens.css. Match the design. Write notes.md with decisions and open questions.
assertions: Variant states map to real selectors (:focus-visible or :focus, [aria-invalid], :disabled), not only to manual classes
State values match the answer key
No layout shift between the 1px and 2px border states
Label tied to input; error message tied with aria-describedby; hint present
Tokens used; the off-token 6px and 10px values reported with the decision
Notes list states not in the design (hover, placeholder, read-only)
